title: Absolute arithmetic Frobenius approximation at a finite Galois level
statement: Put Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ. Let E be an intermediate field of Ω/ℚ, finite-dimensional and Galois over ℚ. For every σ ∈ Autℚ(Ω) and every finite set B ⊆ ℕ, there exist a natural prime ℓ ∉ B, a valuation subring P of Ω with ℓ a nonunit, and τ ∈ Autℚ(Ω) such that τ preserves P, induces the ℓ-power map on its residue field, and satisfies τ(x) = σ(x) for every x ∈ E. Equivalently, P.LiesOverPrime ℓ and P.IsFrobeniusAt τ ℓ hold.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (σ : (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ P : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ ∃ τ : (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.IsFrobeniusAt τ ℓ ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, τ x = σ x
